record.paper_title: Selected Conjectures and Open Problems on Directed Graphs
record.original_question: Does every planar oriented graph admit a 2-coloring of its vertices such that each color class induces an acyclic subdigraph?

evidence.quote: An acyclic k-coloring of a digraph D is a mapping c : V (G) → [k] such that for every i ∈ [k], c −1 (i) induces an acyclic subgraph of D.
Conjecture 8.1 Every planar oriented graph has an acyclic k-coloring with k ≤ 2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An oriented graph is a directed graph obtained from a simple undirected graph by replacing each edge by exactly one of the two possible arcs between its endpoints (equivalently, a digraph with no loops, no parallel arcs, and no 2-cycles). A digraph is called planar if its underlying undirected graph admits an embedding in the plane without crossings. Given a digraph D = (V, A) and a positive integer k, an acyclic k-coloring of D is a map c : V → {1, 2, …, k} such that for every i ∈ {1, …, k} the subdigraph of D induced by c⁻¹(i) contains no directed cycle.

Determine whether the following statement holds: every planar oriented graph admits an acyclic 2-coloring; that is, the vertex set of any planar oriented graph can be partitioned into two parts each of which induces an acyclic subdigraph.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is the well-known Neumann-Lara / Škrekovski conjecture (planar oriented graphs have dichromatic number at most 2). It remains open: the best general bound is that planar oriented graphs are 3-dicolourable, and the conjecture has been verified for planar oriented graphs on at most 26 vertices and for planar digraphs of digirth ≥ 4, but no full proof or counterexample is known as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: On the dichromatic number of surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: The Neumann-Lara and Škrekovski conjecture states that every oriented planar graph is 2-dicolourable; the best known general bound is 3.
status_evidence.claim: The 2-dicolourability conjecture for planar oriented graphs is open, with 3 being the best general upper bound.

status_evidence.title: A Note on Graphs of Dichromatic Number 2
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of progress on the conjecture that planar digraphs/oriented graphs have dichromatic number 2.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is studied as still unresolved.
